description: Aires piétonnes sur Mulhouse is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Mulhouse. Linear location of pedestrian areas in Mulhouse territory. A pedestrian area is a set of streets and alleyways where traffic is reserved for pedestrians and often also for cyclists. Coverage: Ville de Mulhouse. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian areas on Mulhouse" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Mulhouse. Its keywords include deplacement, pieton, circulation, transport, zone, aire. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2026-04-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
